HediffDef.label: human-form role: engineer
HediffDef.description: This human-form Replicator is configured as an engineer. Its role controller prioritises continuous nanite repair of damaged same-faction infrastructure and injured human-form bodies, with faster repair cycles under a commander-grade coordination link.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: infiltrator
HediffDef.description: This human-form Replicator is configured for precision intrusion. When hostile it avoids wasting its mission on nearby defenders where possible and redirects effort toward high-value power, research, communications, fabrication, shield, gravitic and control infrastructure. This is sabotage doctrine, not disguise; visual/faction infiltration remains a separate system.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: soldier
HediffDef.description: This human-form Replicator is configured as a combat specialist. Hostile soldiers actively reprioritise nearby player defenders instead of drifting into generic structure damage, and react more frequently while linked to command-grade coordination.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: coordinator
HediffDef.description: This human-form Replicator is configured as a local lattice coordinator. While its nanites are not EMP-disrupted it projects an eighteen-cell coordination mesh to same-faction human-form Replicators, visibly marking the linked state and improving the response cadence of specialised roles.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: commander
HediffDef.description: This human-form Replicator is configured as a command node. It projects the stronger twenty-eight-cell command mesh and periodically forces fresh continuity backups for nearby linked human-form minds when a compatible powered Pattern Archive is available.

HediffDef.label: human-form coordination mesh
HediffDef.description: This human-form Replicator is inside an active same-faction coordinator or commander mesh. The link accelerates specialist response logic; EMP disruption removes the mesh until coordination can be re-established.
